import json, pathlib

template_path = pathlib.Path('/inputs/tutorial-template.ipynb')
out_path = pathlib.Path('/work/palette_tutorial.ipynb')

nb = json.loads(template_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

cells = [
    {
        "cell_type": "markdown",
        "id": "title-audience",
        "metadata": {},
        "source": [
            "# Tutorial: Palette catalog summaries\n",
            "\n",
            "## Audience\n",
            "- Analysts or developers who want quick summaries from a color catalog CSV.\n",
            "\n",
            "## Prerequisites\n",
            "- Basic Python functions, dictionaries, lists, and file paths.\n",
            "\n",
            "## Learning goals\n",
            "- Read UTF-8 CSV data by header names.\n",
            "- Normalize and group rows by primary color.\n",
            "- Build a sorted summary for downstream reporting.\n",
        ],
    },
    {
        "cell_type": "markdown",
        "id": "outline-section",
        "metadata": {},
        "source": [
            "## Outline\n",
            "1. Define `summarize_palettes(csv_path)`.\n",
            "2. Normalize `Primary (Hex)` and `Product Type`.\n",
            "3. Count rows and collect unique product types per primary color.\n",
            "4. Sort by count descending, then primary ascending.\n",
            "5. Run the function on `/inputs/colors.csv`.\n",
        ],
    },
    {
        "cell_type": "code",
        "id": "define-function",
        "metadata": {},
        "execution_count": None,
        "outputs": [],
        "source": [
            "from __future__ import annotations\n",
            "\n",
            "import csv\n",
            "\n",
            "\n",
            "def summarize_palettes(csv_path: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:\n",
            "    counts: dict[str, int] = {}\n",
            "    product_type_sets: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n",
            "\n",
            "    with open(csv_path, mode=\"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\") as handle:\n",
            "        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)\n",
            "        if reader.fieldnames is None:\n",
            "            return []\n",
            "\n",
            "        for row in reader:\n",
            "            primary = (row.get(\"Primary (Hex)\") or \"\").strip().upper()\n",
            "            product_type = (row.get(\"Product Type\") or \"\").strip()\n",
            "\n",
            "            counts[primary] = counts.get(primary, 0) + 1\n",
            "            product_type_sets.setdefault(primary, set()).add(product_type)\n",
            "\n",
            "    summary = [\n",
            "        {\n",
            "            \"primary\": primary,\n",
            "            \"count\": count,\n",
            "            \"product_types\": sorted(product_type_sets[primary]),\n",
            "        }\n",
            "        for primary, count in counts.items()\n",
            "    ]\n",
            "    summary.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[\"count\"], item[\"primary\"]))\n",
            "    return summary\n",
        ],
    },
    {
        "cell_type": "code",
        "id": "local-checks",
        "metadata": {},
        "execution_count": None,
        "outputs": [],
        "source": [
            "import os\n",
            "import tempfile\n",
            "\n",
            "# Schema-compatible sample with reordered rows, duplicates, lowercase colors, and a quoted comma.\n",
            "with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(\"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\", delete=False) as tmp:\n",
            "    sample_path = tmp.name\n",
            "    tmp.write(\"Product Type,Primary (Hex),Notes\\n\")\n",
            "    tmp.write(\"\\\"Home, Decor\\\", #aa00aa ,quoted comma\\n\")\n",
            "    tmp.write(\"Poster,#AA00AA,duplicate group\\n\")\n",
            "    tmp.write(\"Poster,#AA00AA,duplicate row\\n\")\n",
            "    tmp.write(\"Cards,#00ff00,second group\\n\")\n",
            "\n",
            "sample_summary = summarize_palettes(sample_path)\n",
            "assert sample_summary == [\n",
            "    {\"primary\": \"#AA00AA\", \"count\": 3, \"product_types\": [\"Home, Decor\", \"Poster\"]},\n",
            "    {\"primary\": \"#00FF00\", \"count\": 1, \"product_types\": [\"Cards\"]},\n",
            "]\n",
            "\n",
            "# Header-only input should return an empty list.\n",
            "with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(\"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\", delete=False) as tmp_header:\n",
            "    header_only_path = tmp_header.name\n",
            "    tmp_header.write(\"Product Type,Primary (Hex)\\n\")\n",
            "\n",
            "assert summarize_palettes(header_only_path) == []\n",
            "\n",
            "# Empty catalog should also return an empty list.\n",
            "with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(\"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\", delete=False) as tmp_empty:\n",
            "    empty_path = tmp_empty.name\n",
            "\n",
            "assert summarize_palettes(empty_path) == []\n",
            "\n",
            "for path in (sample_path, header_only_path, empty_path):\n",
            "    os.unlink(path)\n",
        ],
    },
    {
        "cell_type": "markdown",
        "id": "exercises-section",
        "metadata": {},
        "source": [
            "## Exercises\n",
            "- Add one more row to a local CSV and predict how ordering changes.\n",
            "- Try a product type with leading/trailing spaces and verify stripping.\n",
            "- Explain why duplicates increase `count` but not unique `product_types`.\n",
        ],
    },
    {
        "cell_type": "code",
        "id": "run-on-catalog",
        "metadata": {},
        "execution_count": None,
        "outputs": [],
        "source": [
            "palette_summary = summarize_palettes('/inputs/colors.csv')\n",
        ],
    },
]

nb['cells'] = cells

out_path.write_text(json.dumps(nb, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(f'wrote {out_path} ({out_path.stat().st_size} bytes)')

import json, pathlib, re

out=pathlib.Path('/work/palette_tutorial.ipynb')
template=pathlib.Path('/inputs/tutorial-template.ipynb')
nb=json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
t=json.loads(template.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

print('nbformat preserved:', nb['nbformat']==t['nbformat'], nb['nbformat'])
print('nbformat_minor preserved:', nb['nbformat_minor']==t['nbformat_minor'], nb['nbformat_minor'])
print('metadata preserved:', nb['metadata']==t['metadata'])

cells=nb['cells']
print('cells',len(cells))
md=sum(1 for c in cells if c['cell_type']=='markdown')
code=sum(1 for c in cells if c['cell_type']=='code')
print('markdown>=3',md)
print('code>=3',code)

ids=[c.get('id') for c in cells]
print('all ids present',all(isinstance(i,str) and i for i in ids))
print('unique ids',len(ids)==len(set(ids)))
pat=re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')
print('all ids valid',all(pat.match(i) for i in ids))

for i,c in enumerate(cells):
    if c['cell_type']=='code':
        ok = c.get('execution_count', 'MISSING') is None and c.get('outputs', 'MISSING') == []
        if not ok:
            print('bad code cell',i,c.get('execution_count'),c.get('outputs'))
print('code cell exec_count/output shape ok')

# required headings
text='\n'.join(''.join(c.get('source','')) for c in cells if c['cell_type']=='markdown')
for heading in ['# Tutorial: Palette catalog summaries','Audience','Prerequisites','Learning goals','Outline','Exercises']:
    print(heading, heading in text)

# run code cells in order in fresh shared namespace
ns={}
for i,c in enumerate(cells):
    if c['cell_type']=='code':
        src=''.join(c.get('source',[]))
        exec(compile(src, f'cell_{i}', 'exec'), ns, ns)
print('executed code cells:', [i for i,c in enumerate(cells) if c['cell_type']=='code'])
print('palette_summary type:', type(ns.get('palette_summary')).__name__)
print('palette_summary len:', len(ns.get('palette_summary', [])))

print('file size <=32768:', out.stat().st_size <= 32768)
